limits: Stored points are vanilla XP, not AoA skill XP or a count of levels.
A float value is not an exact unlimited integer bank.
Recipe/loot and direct named-reference absence is a bounded acquisition search; external mods or generic registration/data paths are not excluded.
Missing capability can affect storage and rendering; observed source ordering is a runtime test target.
